_about: Oregon groups on the public record against specific climate bills or programs (Nathan, Oct 28: 'start with groups on the record'). Each stance names what was opposed, when, and a public source. Inclusion rule: an organization (not an individual or a local government) that testified 'Oppose' on a core climate bill in OLIS, sued over or backed a suit against the Climate Protection Program, or funded/ran a campaign against a climate ordinance. Left out: solar and renewable firms that opposed details of HB 2021 while backing clean energy; cities, counties and individual testimony. `ogec` = the client name in the Oregon Government Ethics Commission lobbying records.
